newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were generally stable in late trading on Monday as thin buying interest continued, traders said.

They said olein was unchanged at 1,400-05 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, but offers were also heard at 1,410-15 rupiah. Traders said there was no tender taking place on Monday and crude palm oil was last done at 1,239.50 rupiah/kg at a tender last week.
"We had expected that demand will pick up ahead of the Eid al-Adha celebration on Friday. But demand continues to be weak," said one trader.
Another trader said she believed buyers shunned the market because they had already spent money to prepare for the celebrations, which marks the climax of the Moslem pilgrimage to Mecca.
"Maybe they will return to the market just after the celebrations, especially because those who have returned from the pilgrimage will usually hold parties," she said.
Traders said supply was beginning to get tight, possibly due to an increase in exports in previous months.
